title: Editorial
summary: Light, calm and confident, like a well-set magazine page: a serif display face over a clean sans body, warm paper backgrounds, generous whitespace and asymmetric text-and-image splits.
radius: 4px on cards and buttons; images square or 4px. Nothing pill-shaped.
section_padding: 120px top and bottom on desktop, 80px on tablet, 56px on phone. When in doubt, add space, not content.
shadow: None on most elements. At most one very soft shadow (0 12px 32px at 8% black) on a single featured card. Separate blocks with a 1px border in the border colour instead.
rhythm: Alternate the paper background and the white surface section by section. Keep one solid accent-coloured band for the closing call to action, and let the hero breathe on the paper background.
hero: Asymmetric split: a large serif headline and two short lines of copy on the left, one tall photograph on the right. A small uppercase eyebrow line above the headline. One primary button, one quiet text link.
cta: A full-width band in the accent colour with a short serif headline, one sentence and a single button in the surface colour. No second button, no form fields beyond the essentials.

title: Glass dark
summary: Dark and modern: a deep navy gradient behind everything, translucent cards with a light border, bright blue accents and crisp sans type. Feels like a product or software page.
radius: 20px on cards, 12px on buttons and images. Keep every corner of one card the same.
section_padding: 100px top and bottom on desktop, 72px on tablet, 48px on phone.
shadow: No drop shadows; depth comes from layers. Cards use a semi-transparent background (rgba of the text colour at about 6%) with a 1px border at about 12% white. Real frosted-glass blur is not available in Divi's settings, so do not promise it.
rhythm: Every section sits on the same deep background; vary the gradient direction or depth from section to section (a lighter navy glow behind the hero, a deeper tone further down). Use a grid of translucent cards for features and proof, and keep the closing call to action on a gradient from the accent colour toward the background.
hero: Centered: a short eyebrow, a bold headline in the text colour, one muted sentence, two buttons (solid accent plus a bordered ghost button), and a product image or card below with a soft glow behind it.
cta: A centered translucent card on a gradient background with one headline, one sentence and one accent-coloured button.

title: Organic warm
summary: Soft, earthy and human, like a ceramics studio or a family bakery: sand and clay tints, a friendly serif for headings, large rounded shapes and sections that overlap like layers of paper.
radius: Generous and organic: 28px on cards and panels, 999px on buttons and tags, images with 32px corners or an arch shape (large radius on the top two corners only). Nothing sharp.
section_padding: 96px top and bottom on desktop, 64px on tablet, 44px on phone. Let sections touch and overlap a little instead of leaving hard gaps.
shadow: Soft and warm: 0 18px 40px at 10% of the text colour, never grey. No borders on cards; separate blocks by changing the tint (sand to cream), not by drawing lines.
rhythm: Earthy tints in layers: sand background for the hero, cream surface for the next section, then a deep moss band with the inverse text colour, then back to sand. Let one image or card overlap the edge of the section above it. Use the section divider style wave or curve between tints, and keep every section calm with one idea each.
hero: Warm and inviting: a large friendly serif headline over a sand background, two relaxed lines of copy and a pill-shaped moss button, beside a photograph with arch-shaped corners that overlaps the section below.
cta: A cream rounded panel sitting on the moss band, with a short warm headline, one reassuring sentence about what happens next and a single pill button.

title: Tech mono
summary: Precise and engineered, like developer documentation or a terminal: near-black backgrounds, a monospace body face, one neon accent, hairline borders and strict grids with no softness.
radius: Almost none: 2px on buttons, inputs and cards, images square. Never rounder than 4px anywhere.
section_padding: 88px top and bottom on desktop, 64px on tablet, 40px on phone. Tight, even, repeated: the same padding on every section.
shadow: No shadows at all. Structure comes from 1px hairline borders in the border colour and from visible grid lines between cells. The accent colour is reserved for the primary button and one small marker per section; links stay in the text colour with an underline.
rhythm: One near-black background for the whole page. Divide sections with a single hairline rule instead of a colour change, and lay features and proof out on a ruled grid of equal cells. Use small monospace labels for numbers, versions and steps. Reserve the neon accent for the primary button and one small marker per section, nothing else.
hero: Left-aligned and literal: a small monospace eyebrow that looks like a command or version label, a tight geometric headline, two lines of plain copy, a neon button and a quiet bordered button, and a ruled code-like card or screenshot on the right.
cta: A bordered full-width block with a monospace headline, one line of copy and a single neon button; below it a one-line install or contact snippet in muted text.

title: Playful pastel
summary: Cheerful and bouncy, like a children's brand, a game or a creative studio: a different soft pastel behind each section, very round shapes, a rounded display face and friendly big buttons.
radius: Big and round: 36px on cards and panels, 999px on buttons, tags and avatars, circles for icons and some images. Mix in one blob or tilted shape per page.
section_padding: 88px top and bottom on desktop, 60px on tablet, 40px on phone. Generous but lively; cards sit close together.
shadow: A chunky offset look: a 2px border in the text colour on buttons and cards, with the closest shadow preset on the button module, or an offset shadow in the text colour where the box shadow settings allow it. Never a soft grey shadow. Never use the pink as a text or link colour (pink on cream or any pastel is far below readable contrast); pink is for button and tag backgrounds only, with the deep indigo text colour on top.
rhythm: Give each section its own pastel in sequence: cream, then butter yellow (#ffe9a8), mint (#c9f0dd), sky (#cfe6ff), lilac (#e2d6ff) and back to cream. White cards sit on top of the tints. Keep text in the deep indigo text colour on every tint. Add one icon or one of the built-in pack shapes (get_image_guide) per section, and on hover scale buttons to 108%.
hero: Centered and chatty: a big rounded headline in the deep indigo text colour, a small pink pill-shaped tag above it, a short cheerful sentence, a big pink pill-shaped button and a small secondary link, with a tilted photo card beside the text.
cta: A lilac or butter-yellow band with a big friendly headline, a one-line promise and a large pink button with a chunky outline; a tiny smiling note below it.

title: Corporate trust
summary: Restrained, credible and clear, like a bank, a law firm or a B2B service: white pages, deep navy text and bands, one calm blue accent, small corners and plenty of facts, lists and numbers.
radius: Small and consistent: 6px on cards, buttons and inputs; images square or 6px. No pills, no circles except avatars.
section_padding: 96px top and bottom on desktop, 68px on tablet, 44px on phone. Steady and predictable from section to section.
shadow: Very light: a 1px border in the border colour on cards, and at most 0 2px 8px at 8% navy on a hovered card. No glow, no heavy depth.
rhythm: White and pale blue-grey in alternation, with one deep navy band that carries the numbers (years, clients, results) in the inverse text colour. Open each section with a small blue eyebrow and a plain headline. Back every claim with a figure, a logo row, a certificate or a named testimonial, and use checklists and numbered steps for how it works.
hero: Clear and sober: a two-column hero with a plain navy headline that states the service and who it is for, one supporting sentence, a blue primary button and a text link for pricing or contact, next to a team or office photograph and a row of client logos underneath. The photograph and logos are placeholders the owner will replace: never invent client names, logos, quotes or statistics.
cta: A deep navy band with a short headline in the inverse colour, one sentence about the next step (a call, a consultation, a quote) and a single button in the surface colour, with the phone number beside it.

title: Soft SaaS
summary: Friendly and polished, like a modern software product: a pale lavender page with white rounded cards, soft tinted sections, gentle gradients, an indigo accent and a product screenshot in the hero.
radius: 16px on cards, panels and images, 12px on buttons and inputs. Set all four corners of every element explicitly. Nothing sharp and nothing pill-shaped.
section_padding: 104px top and bottom on desktop, 72px on tablet, 48px on phone. Cards inside a section sit 24px apart.
shadow: Soft and cool, never grey and never heavy. On a card or panel use box shadow preset3 with a vertical offset of 16px, a blur of 40px and the colour rgba(30,33,64,0.10); always set the preset first, because offsets and colours do nothing without it. Cards also carry a 1px border in the border colour. Buttons get no shadow of their own: the primary button has the accent background and, on hover, the deeper indigo #3730a3.
rhythm: Light all the way down, in gentle steps: the lavender page background for the hero, a white section, a section with a soft linear gradient at 180deg from the background colour to a deeper tint (#e8ebff), another white section, then one accent-coloured band that carries the inverse text colour. White rounded cards sit on the tints. Put a trust row right under the hero and a three-card feature grid after it, and let each card lift 8px on hover. Entrance motion: one fade on the hero headline and on the first row of cards, nothing else.
hero: Split: on the left a short eyebrow, a two-line headline in the text colour, one muted sentence and two buttons (solid accent, then a quiet bordered one); on the right a product screenshot in a 16px-cornered card with a soft circular gradient glow behind it, from a low-opacity accent to fully transparent. Under the buttons sits a trust row of three short lines. The screenshot (Media Library first, otherwise a picture from the built-in pack) and every trust line are placeholders the owner replaces: never invent customer names, logos, ratings, awards or statistics.
cta: The closing accent band: a headline in the inverse text colour, one sentence about what happens after signing up and a single button in the surface colour with the accent colour as its text. A small reassurance line below it that the owner confirms is true. No second button.

title: Bold vibrant
summary: Loud, confident and energetic, like a campaign site or a challenger brand: saturated colour blocks, very heavy wide headlines, black text on yellow, cobalt and pink, and sections that sit hard against each other.
radius: Sharp blocks with one soft corner pair: full-width blocks and images square; cards and panels 32px on the top-left and bottom-right corners and 0px on the other two (set all four corners explicitly); buttons 8px.
section_padding: 80px top and bottom on desktop, 56px on tablet, 36px on phone. Tight: the headline should take most of the room.
shadow: No soft shadows. Weight comes from colour and borders: a 3px solid border in the text colour on cards and on the secondary button, on a card background in the surface colour. On hover a card rotates 3 degrees and a button scales to 108%. The cobalt is a background colour: put the inverse text colour on it.
rhythm: Full-bleed colour blocks, one idea per block, a new colour every section: the yellow background colour for the hero, then white, then a cobalt block in the inverse text colour, then a pink block (#ff5fa8) with the text colour on it, then a block in the text colour with the inverse text colour on it, then yellow again. Close the hero with a slant divider 60px high and give the section below it a plain background colour. Put a polka-dots pattern at rgba(12,12,20,0.12) on one block. Photos pop: contrast 130% and saturate 180% on the image module. Entrance motion: headlines slide in from the bottom (800ms) and cards fade in 150ms after each other.
hero: Stacked: a huge headline across the full width in the text colour on the yellow background (weight 800, line height 1em), one short sentence below it, then a row with a cobalt button (inverse text) and a bordered white button, and a photo or pink block pulled up over the bottom of the hero with a negative top margin. Everything is left-aligned.
cta: A full-width cobalt block: a huge headline in the inverse text colour, one short line and one large button in the surface colour with the text colour on it. One button only.

title: Brutalist flat
summary: Raw, flat and blunt, like an independent magazine or a studio manifesto: flat colour, thick black borders, square corners, no shadows and a visible grid, with a heavy grotesk for headlines and a mono face for labels.
radius: 0px everywhere: cards, panels, images, buttons and inputs. Set all four corners to 0px. Nothing round, not even avatars.
section_padding: 64px top and bottom on desktop, 48px on tablet, 32px on phone. Dense, with content running close to the borders.
shadow: No shadows at all: leave the box shadow unset. Structure is drawn with a 4px solid border in the text colour on every card, panel, image and button. The orange accent is for backgrounds only, with black text on it: never use it as a text or link colour, because it is far too weak on the paper background.
rhythm: Flat blocks of raw colour, no gradients: paper background, white, paper, then one orange block, then an acid block (#d4ff3a) with black text, then paper again. Lay features out as a grid of three equal cells, each with its own 4px black border. Open every section with a 6px black line (the divider module). Use the mono face in capital letters for labels and index numbers such as 01, 02, 03. No entrance animation and no scroll effects: on hover a button swaps to a black background with the inverse text colour.
hero: Left-aligned and loud: a headline in the grotesk face at weight 900, in capital letters, as big as the width allows, inside a panel with a 4px black border on the paper background; under it a grid of three bordered cells, each with a mono index label and one line of copy, and one orange button with black text and a 4px black border. If a photo is used it is square, with a 4px black border and a saturate filter of 0%.
cta: One orange panel with a 4px black border: a headline in capital letters, one line of copy and a single black button with white text and a 4px black border.

title: Luxe
summary: Quiet, expensive and unhurried, like a boutique hotel, a jeweller or a private clinic: warm near-black backgrounds, ivory text, a restrained gold accent, a tall light serif for headlines, hairline rules and a great deal of empty space.
radius: 0px on cards and images, 2px at most on buttons and inputs. Nothing rounded.
section_padding: 160px top and bottom on desktop, 112px on tablet, 72px on phone. Emptiness is the design: one idea per section, and leave the rest empty.
shadow: No shadows. Depth comes from the tone step between the background and the surface colour and from 1px borders in the border colour. The gold is for one thin rule, the eyebrow label and the primary button fill only: never for body text and never over a large area.
rhythm: One warm near-black page: the background colour and the surface colour alternate section by section, and a hairline divider module (1px line in the accent colour) separates ideas inside a section. Headlines are the serif at weight 300 with generous line height. Eyebrow labels are in capital letters with 0.1em letter spacing. Full-bleed photography sits under a gradient scrim whose two stops are both the overlay colour, with the inverse text colour on it. Motion is slow: one fade entrance of 2000ms with the ease-out speed curve on each headline, the hero headline included, one background parallax on the hero photograph, nothing else.
hero: Centered and full-height (85vh): a full-bleed photograph under a gradient scrim whose two stops are both the overlay colour, a small gold eyebrow in capital letters, a very large light serif headline in the inverse text colour, one short line in the inverse text colour and a single gold button with the dark accent text colour on it. Nothing else.
cta: A full-width panel in the surface colour with a hairline rule above it: a short serif headline, one sentence inviting a private visit or conversation, and a single gold button with the dark accent text colour on it.
